items.question: How much did it cost Tesla to build each car in Q4 2024 and what drove the change?
items.ground_truth: COGS per vehicle hit its lowest level ever at under $35,000, driven largely by raw material cost improvement, which partly offset the investment in financing and lease options.

items.question: Why did operating income fall year over year in Q4 2024?
items.ground_truth: Reduced S3XY average selling price and higher operating expenses driven by AI and other R&D projects. These were partly offset by Energy and Services and Other gross profit growth, lower cost per vehicle (lower raw material costs) and higher regulatory credit revenue.
evidence: Our operating income decreased 23% YoY to $1.6B in Q4

items.question: What factors affected the year-over-year change in revenue in Q4 2024?
items.ground_truth: Positive: growth in Energy and Services and Other, growth in vehicle deliveries, higher regulatory credit revenue. Negative: reduced S3XY average selling price due to pricing, financing options and mix.
evidence: Total revenue increased 2% YoY in Q4 to $25.7B

items.question: What is Cortex and what was it used for?
items.ground_truth: Cortex is a ~50k H100 training cluster at Gigafactory Texas, deployed in Q4, which helped enable FSD (Supervised) V13.
evidence: Cortex, a ~50k H100 training cluster at Gigafactory

items.question: What improvements came with FSD (Supervised) V13?
items.ground_truth: A 4.2x increase in data, higher resolution video inputs, a 2x reduction in photon-to-control latency and a redesigned controller; it can also start from park and do unpark, reverse and park.
evidence: 4.2x increase in data, higher resolution video inputs

items.question: How did Tesla's Autopilot safety record compare with the U.S. average in Q4 2024?
items.ground_truth: Vehicles using Autopilot technology drove 5.94 million miles between accidents, versus the U.S. average of 0.70 million miles.

items.question: What is Tesla's outlook for energy storage deployments in 2025?
items.ground_truth: Tesla expects energy storage deployments to grow at least 50% year over year in 2025.
evidence: energy storage deployments to grow at least 50% year-over-year in 2025

items.question: What does Tesla say about new, more affordable vehicles and its maximum vehicle capacity?
items.ground_truth: Production of new vehicles including more affordable models is on track to start in H1 2025, built on current manufacturing lines. Current expected maximum capacity is close to three million vehicles, i.e. more than 60% growth over 2024 production before new lines are needed.
evidence: close to three million vehicles, enabling more than 60% growth over 2024 production

items.question: When is volume production of Cybercab planned?
items.ground_truth: 2026, using an 'unboxed' manufacturing strategy (Cybercab lines are being prepared at Gigafactory Texas).
evidence: scheduled for volume production starting in 2026

items.question: What is the timeline for the Semi factory?
items.ground_truth: First truck builds are scheduled to start by the end of 2025 with ramp beginning in early 2026; roof and wall enclosure of the main building area was recently completed.
evidence: First truck builds are scheduled to start by end of 2025

items.question: What is the installed annual vehicle capacity of Shanghai and Berlin?

items.question: How does Tesla describe progress on its lithium refinery?
items.ground_truth: It processed its first spodumene through the front-end of the refinery only 18 months after ground-breaking; the intermediate material was on-spec and the plant is on track to be commissioned in 2025.
evidence: We processed our first spodumene (lithium-containing concentrate)

items.question: What did Tesla report about its 4680 cell production?
items.ground_truth: The in-house 4680 cell hit a production rate exceeding 2.5k Cybertrucks per week.
evidence: Our in-house 4680 cell hit a production rate exceeding 2.5k Cybertrucks/week

items.question: Which new Supercharger cabinet did Tesla unveil and what are its specs?
items.ground_truth: The V4 cabinet supports 400V-1,000V architectures, charges up to 500kW for passenger vehicles and 1.2MW for Tesla Semi, with 3x the power density.
evidence: We unveiled our V4 cabinet, which supports 400V-1,000V vehicle architectures

items.question: How did the Supercharger network grow in 2024?
items.ground_truth: Superchargers launched in three new countries, over 10k new stalls were added, the network grew 19% year over year to 65k+ Superchargers, and 5.2+ TWh was delivered.
evidence: launched Superchargers in three new countries, added over 10k new Supercharger stalls

items.question: What did Tesla do with Cybertrucks during the Los Angeles fires?
items.ground_truth: It deployed a fleet of Cybertrucks equipped with Starlink to give first responders and affected people access to electricity (Powershare) and Wi-Fi.
evidence: we deployed a fleet of Cybertrucks equipped with Starlink in the Los Angeles area

items.question: What does Tesla say about the New Model Y Launch Series price and range?
items.ground_truth: The Launch Series Long Range AWD starts at $46,490 after estimated savings, with an estimated 320 miles of range, available starting March.

items.question: What are the key technical benefits of the Cybertruck 48-volt electrical architecture?
items.ground_truth: It reduces current by 4x and heat generated by 16x compared with typical automotive voltage, reduces harness weight, improves energy efficiency and simplifies electrical systems.
evidence: 48-volt electrical system reduces current by 4x and heat generated by 16x

items.question: How fast is Etherloop communication and what does it eliminate?

items.question: How does Tesla define Adjusted EBITDA?
items.ground_truth: Net income attributable to common stockholders before (a) interest expense, (b) provision for income taxes, (c) depreciation, amortization and impairment and (d) stock-based compensation expense.
evidence: "Adjusted EBITDA" is equal to (i) net income (loss) attributable to common stockholders
